reason: Method relies on COT positioning extremes plus discretionary news-failure confirmation on futures/indices; no concrete long-only daily-bar rules for US stocks.

universe.description: stock indices and commodities futures via COT

setup.rule: Speculators extremely long (commercials extremely short) or vice versa
setup.quote: when commercials are extremely short and speculators are extremely long that's when a good turn can happen

entry.rule: Wait for news-failure confirmation on the crowded side
entry.quote: I'm looking for what I like to call a news failure event ... if I'm looking to get long I'm looking for some kind of bearish news to come out and then the market to not go down on that news

stop.rule: Exit when speculator crowding returns to neutral
stop.quote: I'm entering when things are showing speculators super crowded I am therefore exiting when speculators are no more no longer crowded

exits.rule: Mean-reversion in participation to neutral (not full opposite extreme)
exits.quote: I get out at the neutral point

sizing.rule: Risk management per trade with correlation adjustment across portfolio
sizing.quote: each individual trade has its own risk management ... if the trades are highly correlated then it's really not one trade

market_filter.rule: Only act when COT extremes align with news-failure tape action
market_filter.quote: I'm not going to just get along because of that right I'm going to wait for the market to confirm this

ambiguities.issue: No numeric thresholds or exact COT percentile rules given
